role: Historical physician comparing physical vapour and water
timing: Declared to coordinator after reading the three complete assigned paragraphs, before inspecting further occurrences for this new meaning. Not blind or preregistered before those local readings.

proposal.fixed_sense: Change of state or constitution of the grammatical subject into the expressed result; not an imperative, identity copula, future auxiliary, making action, heating, or condensation as another separate sense.
proposal.motivation: The already read f77r.35 has a possible vapour subject and water result separated by the unknown whole chedy; medieval physical texts explicitly describe vapour becoming water.

f81v.19 solkeey ol shedy has neither adjacent chedy nor a written qokain.
f83r.52--55 contains neither chedy nor qokain; an omitted transformation predicate or water result must not be inserted.
